summary_for_vector_search: A high-level technical leader with over 8 years of experience in designing scalable distributed systems and migrating legacy monoliths to microservices. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in low-level systems programming (Rust, Go, C++) combined with modern AI infrastructure knowledge (PyTorch, LLMs). They must demonstrate a track record of technical leadership, architectural decision-making for high-traffic environments, and the ability to bridge the gap between complex infrastructure and AI application layers.
must_haves: 8+ years of experience in Systems Architecture or Principal Engineering
Expertise in Systems Programming (Rust, Go, or C++)
Proven track record of Monolith-to-Microservices migration
Deep knowledge of Container Orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker) and Cloud Infrastructure (AWS)
nice_to_haves: Experience with AI/ML infrastructure (PyTorch, CUDA, LLMs)
Open Source contributions or public technical speaking
Background in Kernel development or Embedded Systems
deal_breakers: Lack of backend/systems engineering experience (e.g., Frontend-only background)
No experience with high-scale or distributed systems
Reliance solely on high-level abstractions without understanding underlying mechanics
cultural_vibe: Engineering-first environment valuing raw technical depth, autonomous problem solving, and brutal efficiency. We prefer builders who understand the entire stack from the kernel to the cloud.
